tools.name: list_quote_forms
tools.description: List the insurance quote request forms Susman Insurance Agency offers (auto, home, condo, renters, landlord, earthquake, flood, life and more), with a short description, question count and the human web page for each.

tools.name: get_form_questions
tools.description: Return every question of one quote request form: the name to answer with, the question text, type, choices, whether it is required, and a visibleIf rule when it only applies after another answer. tools.name: submit_quote_request
tools.description: Send the person's answers to Susman Insurance Agency as a quote request. Only call this for a real person who asked you to and confirmed the answers, using their real name and email; never send test data. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_quote_forms · Public sink: submit_quote_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_quote_forms · Public sink: submit_quote_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
